_evidence: 0x00444837 passes the parts mask [ebx+0x4c] to 0x444517 (Parts_ComputeMassProperties), which divides by the summed masses of the selected parts: a mask with none of the low 23 bits set (rec_0042453d draws 0) divides by zero, so the overlay keeps the low 23 bits nonzero (single parts, part groups and all parts). +0x6f is the part-state byte.
